title: ChannelConfig
description:
Settings for one channel: where its playout is, which ffmpeg to use, and the output format.
A relative path in any of these settings is relative to the file that sets it.

fallback.description: What plays when nothing is scheduled or an item fails.

normalization.description: Output format for audio, video and subtitles.

playout.description: Where to find the channel's playout files.

version.description: Schema version URI, e.g. "https://ersatztv.org/channel/version/0.1.0". Missing means 0.0.0.

AudioCopyFormat.title: AudioCopyFormat
AudioCopyFormat.description: Limited to codecs that mux correctly into HLS MPEG-TS.

integrated_target.description: Integrated loudness target in LUFS (`loudnorm` `I`). Unset is -16.

range_target.description: Loudness range target in LU (`loudnorm` `LRA`). Unset is 11.

true_peak.description: Maximum true peak in dBTP (`loudnorm` `TP`). Unset is -1.5.

bitrate_kbps.description: Bitrate in kbit/s. Unset leaves it to the encoder.

buffer_kbps.description: Rate control buffer size (`-bufsize`) in kbit/s. Unset leaves it to the encoder.

channels.description: Number of channels, e.g. `2` for stereo. Unset keeps the source channel count.

copy_formats.description: Source codecs to copy when `mode` is `copy`. Default: aac, ac3, eac3, mp3.

format.description: Codec for transcoded items. When `mode` is `copy`, used only for items that are not copied.

mode.description: Whether to transcode every item or copy items whose codec allows it.

normalize_loudness.description:
Normalize loudness with the ffmpeg `loudnorm` filter to the `loudness` targets.
Not allowed when `mode` is `copy`.

sample_rate_hz.description:
Sample rate in Hz, e.g. `48000`. Unset keeps the source rate, or 48000 when
`normalize_loudness` is on.

mode.description: Value for the `bwdif_cuda` `mode` option. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, `_`, `.`, `+`, `-`.
Value for the `bwdif` `mode` option. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, `_`, `.`, `+`, `-`.

direct_nv12_handoff.description:
When `native_nv12_output` is not requested or the active layout is ineligible,
still hand libplacebo's nv12 straight back to VAAPI without `scale_vulkan`.
Needs the same patched ffmpeg.

hdr_vaapi_lut.description:
Draw HDR10 sources too: scale to `custom_shader_input_height` in 10-bit, tone-map with
`tonemap_vaapi_lut` (fixed Hable), then draw. Needs that ffmpeg filter and an input
height; otherwise HDR sources play without the shader.

input_scale_mode.description:
`scale_vaapi` `mode` for the `custom_shader_input_height` scale, e.g. `default` to let the
driver use its dedicated scaler. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, `_`.

native_nv12_output.description:
Have libplacebo write nv12 straight into the output frame (`nv12_output=native`) instead
of converting with `scale_vulkan`. Needs an ffmpeg whose libplacebo has that option, and
applies to positive-even active picture dimensions before any padding.

point_chroma.description:
With `native_nv12_output`, point-sample the output chroma instead of filtering it with
Mitchell. Faster; fine chroma detail can alias.

mode.description:
Value for the `deinterlace_qsv` `mode` option. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, `_`, `.`, `+`,
`-`.

Value for the `deinterlace_vaapi` `mode` option. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, `_`, `.`,
`+`, `-`.

FallbackConfig.description:
Controls the content that replaces scheduled content when there is nothing to play
(a gap in the playout) or when the scheduled item fails

background_image.description:
Still image shown instead of black, scaled and padded to the output size. Black is used
if the image fails to play.

duration_seconds.description:
Fallback length in seconds when the fallback has no end time, e.g. after a failed
dynamic source. Default 60. Raised to the source's `retry_budget_ms` if shorter.

show_error.description:
Burn the reason for the fallback into the fallback video; this is always burned,
regardless of the normalization subtitle mode

degradation_report.description:
File the channel rewrites as each item starts, listing every item that hasn't ended and
where each runs other than as configured (hardware it could not use, a custom shader it did
not draw). Keep it out of the output folder, which is served to clients. Unset writes none.

disabled_filters.description:
ffmpeg video filters to never use, even when the ffmpeg build has them, e.g.
`["scale_cuda"]`. Pipelines that need one use another filter or software instead.

ffmpeg_path.description: Path to the ffmpeg executable. Unset or empty uses `ffmpeg` from `PATH`.

ffprobe_path.description: Path to the ffprobe executable. Unset or empty uses `ffprobe` from `PATH`.

preferred_filters.description:
ffmpeg video filters in order of preference, used when more than one filter can do the
same step, e.g. `["tonemap_vaapi", "tonemap_opencl"]`.

reports_folder.description:
Folder for troubleshooting reports. When set, each failed item or fallback writes a
subfolder with the ffmpeg output, the channel config and media info. Unset writes none.

tonemapping.description:
Value for the `libplacebo` `tonemapping` option. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, `_`, `.`,
`+`, `-`.

virtual_start.description:
Play the playout as if the channel started at this time instead of now. RFC 3339, e.g.
`2026-04-13T00:24:21.527-05:00`. For testing.

flags.description:
Flags for the software `scale` filter, e.g. `bicubic`, `lanczos`, `fast_bilinear`.
Default is `bicubic`. Also applies to graphics, image subtitles, and hardware accels that
use the software scaler.

mode.description:
FFmpeg `scale_vaapi` mode, e.g. `default` for the driver's scaler or `hq`.
Omitted leaves FFmpeg's existing choice unchanged.

oneOf.description: Scale to fit inside the frame and pad the rest with black.
Scale to fill the frame, ignoring the aspect ratio.
Scale to cover the frame and crop the overflow.
Copy items with a source codec in `copy_formats`. Transcode all other items.
Convert text subtitles to a WebVTT track in the HLS stream.

fonts_folder.description: Folder of fonts for burned-in text subtitles.

force_style.description:
ASS style overrides for burned-in text subtitles, e.g. `FontName=Arial,FontSize=24`
(the `subtitles` filter's `force_style` option).

mode.description: What to do with the selected text subtitle track. Image subtitles are always burned in.

oneOf.description: Convert HDR to SDR using the existing mapper.
Preserve compatible HDR; otherwise convert to SDR and report the reason.
Never tone-map. Unsupported HDR output reports an error and uses the configured fallback.

tonemap.description:
Value for the `tonemap_opencl` `tonemap` option. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, `_`, `.`,
`+`, `-`.
Value for the `tonemap` `tonemap` option. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, `_`, `.`, `+`, `-`.

oneOf.description: Intel media driver, for Broadwell and newer.
Legacy Intel driver, for older Intel GPUs.

Use low-power for HEVC when it supports bitrate rate control. Faster on Intel iGPUs with
both entrypoints; slightly lower quality on grainy sources.
Use the default entrypoint when the GPU has it.

Use low-power for every format, including H.264, when it supports bitrate rate control.
H.264 on VDEnc is not faster, but it moves encoding off the EUs and leaves them to other
GPU work (e.g. concurrent shader filters). Falls back to the default entrypoint when
low-power is unavailable.

bwdif.description:
Options for the [`bwdif`](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#bwdif-1) filter, used for
software deinterlacing.

bwdif_cuda.description:
Options for the [`bwdif_cuda`](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#bwdif_005fcuda)
filter, used for CUDA deinterlacing.

deinterlace_qsv.description:
Options for the `deinterlace_qsv` filter, used for QSV deinterlacing. Run
`ffmpeg -h filter=deinterlace_qsv` for its options.

deinterlace_vaapi.description:
Options for the `deinterlace_vaapi` filter, used for VAAPI deinterlacing. Run
`ffmpeg -h filter=deinterlace_vaapi` for its options.

libplacebo.description:
Options for the [`libplacebo`](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#libplacebo) filter,
used for CUDA and Vulkan tonemapping.

scale.description:
Options for the [`scale`](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#scale-1) filter, used for
software scaling.

scale_vaapi.description: Options for VAAPI video and bitmap-subtitle resizing. Requires the fork worker.

tonemap.description:
Options for the [`tonemap`](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#tonemap-1) filter, used
for software tonemapping.

tonemap_opencl.description:
Options for the
[`tonemap_opencl`](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#tonemap_005fopencl) filter, used
for VAAPI tonemapping.

w3fdif.description:
Options for the [`w3fdif`](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#w3fdif) filter, used for
software deinterlacing.

yadif.description:
Options for the [`yadif`](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#yadif-1) filter, used for
software deinterlacing.

yadif_cuda.description:
Options for the [`yadif_cuda`](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#yadif_005fcuda)
filter, used for CUDA deinterlacing.

accel.description:
Hardware acceleration for decoding, filtering and encoding. Steps the device can't do use
software. If the device can't be probed, the whole channel uses software. Unset or empty
uses software.

amf_device.description: AMF adapter index. Windows only. Unset picks the discrete AMD adapter.

bitrate_kbps.description: Bitrate in kbit/s. Required for `mpeg2video`. Unset leaves it to the encoder.

buffer_kbps.description: Rate control buffer size (`-bufsize`) in kbit/s. Unset leaves it to the encoder.

copy_formats.description: Source codecs to copy when `mode` is `copy`. Default: h264, hevc.

custom_shader.description:
A libplacebo user shader (mpv-style `//!HOOK` GLSL), drawn while scaling each frame to the
output picture, before padding, subtitles and graphics. Runs only with `vaapi`, when
ffmpeg has `libplacebo` and a Vulkan device on the same GPU can import its frames. Skipped
for HDR sources. Elsewhere the channel plays without it.

custom_shader_input_height.description:
Lines to scale the picture to, keeping its shape, before `custom_shader` draws it at the
output size. For shaders that soften the picture to a lower resolution, e.g. `480`. Unset
draws from the source picture.

custom_shader_options.description: How the `custom_shader` stage runs. Each option applies only where ffmpeg supports it.

deinterlace.description: Deinterlace interlaced sources. Progressive sources are not changed.

filters.description: Options for individual ffmpeg filters. Unset options use the filter's default.

format.description:
Codec for transcoded items. When `mode` is `copy`, this and all other video settings apply
only to items that are not copied.

frame_rate.description:
Output frame rate, `N` or `N/D` (e.g. `25`, `30000/1001`).
Frames are dropped or repeated to match it.
In `copy` mode, only items at this rate are copied. Unset keeps the source rate.

hdr_vaapi_lut.description:
Prefer the fixed-Hable VAAPI LUT for eligible HDR10 to 8-bit SDR conversions.
Requires the patched FFmpeg filter; unsupported inputs retain the existing mapper.

height.description:
Height in pixels. Applies only when `width` is also set; otherwise the source size is kept.
The fallback uses 1080 when unset.

mode.description:
Whether to transcode every item or copy items whose codec allows it. In `copy` mode, items
with graphics, burned-in subtitles, still images, Dolby Vision profile 5 or AVI sources are
always transcoded, as is video most players cannot decode: 10-bit H.264, and 4:2:2 or 4:4:4
H.264 or HEVC.

preserve_source_aspect.description:
Preserve each transcoded item's display aspect ratio without baked-in bars, while
keeping the configured encoded width and height. Overrides `scaling_mode`; copied
video and channels without an output size are unchanged. Requires a supporting fork
worker and a player that honors aspect changes at program boundaries. Default false.

scaling_mode.description: How a source with a different aspect ratio fits `width` and `height`.

tone_mapping.description:
HDR conversion policy for transcoded video. Defaults to on. Preserving HDR requires
compatible 10-bit output and an HDR-capable player/display; copied video is unchanged.

vaapi_driver.description: VAAPI driver. Unset lets libva select the driver for `vaapi_device`.

vaapi_low_power.description:
Whether VAAPI encoding may use the low-power entrypoint (Intel VDEnc) when the GPU also has
the default one: for HEVC with `auto`, for every format with `always`. Default `auto`.

width.description:
Width in pixels. Applies only when `height` is also set; otherwise the source size is kept.
The fallback uses 1920 when unset.

mode.description: Value for the `w3fdif` `mode` option. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, `_`, `.`, `+`, `-`.
Value for the `yadif_cuda` `mode` option. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, `_`, `.`, `+`, `-`.
Value for the `yadif` `mode` option. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, `_`, `.`, `+`, `-`.
